audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup calls Mel's ultimate "Rekindled Ember", puts Solar Snare on her W, and calls her R a reflect. Three separate slot/name errors in one entry.
audit.why: Mel's kit is P Searing Brilliance, Q Radiant Volley, W Rebuttal, E Solar Snare, R Golden Eclipse. The reflect/damage-immunity barrier is W (Rebuttal). Solar Snare is the E root. Golden Eclipse is a global Overwhelm detonation with 25000 range — nothing to do with reflecting. "Rekindled Ember" is not a Mel ability at all.
audit.corrected: W = Rebuttal (reflect + damage immunity, 38/35/33/29/26s). E = Solar Snare (root, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s). R = Golden Eclipse (global, 120/100/80s).

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing tells the Zac player that Rebuttal is the ability their all-in has to bait, and that it prevents damage outright rather than merely reflecting.
audit.why: Rebuttal's own text is "forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed". Committing E + Q + W into an up Rebuttal spends Zac's whole pattern for zero. At rank 1 it is a 38s cooldown — the longest window in the lane and the one the player should be counting.
audit.corrected: Bait Rebuttal, then commit. Rank 1 is 38s; you get a free full pattern every time she burns it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked cooldown was written as a single vague "Solar Snare" with no number, and the genuinely decisive cooldown (Rebuttal) was absent.
audit.why: Solar Snare is 11s at rank 1 and only 9s at rank 5 — it is up for most trades and is not the window. Rebuttal at 38s is.
audit.corrected: Track two clocks: Solar Snare 11s (dodge it) and Rebuttal 38s (the actual all-in window).

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was framed as "her R reflect" punishing your all-in.
audit.why: Golden Eclipse has 25000 range and hits every enemy marked with Overwhelm regardless of distance. Disengaging out of her range does not save you once you are stacked — the counterplay is stack management, not distance.
audit.corrected: At 6 her R closes from anywhere; what changes at 6 is that walking away stops working, not that she gains a reflect.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-1 section said Mel out-ranges Zac without saying by how much.
audit.why: Radiant Volley is 950 range against Zac's 800-range Stretching Strikes, so she wins the level-1 spacing war by 150 units and the correct play is to soak rather than contest.
audit.corrected: Radiant Volley 950 vs your Q at 800.

audit.why: Mel is written with male pronouns throughout the full layer ("slingshot him", "a trade he paid for"). Corrected where the string was uniquely addressable.

edits.before: Mel's R (Rekindled Ember) and her W (Solar Snare) root plus Executioner passive spike her burst, and her R reflect can turn your all-in against you — respect it.
edits.after: Mel's R is Golden Eclipse, a global Overwhelm detonation, and Solar Snare is her E root; the reflect is W (Rebuttal) and that is what your all-in has to bait.

edits.before: With a health item your E-into-R (Let's Bounce!) engage buries her before she can channel; she can't out-DPS a tank sitting on top.
edits.after: With a health item your E-into-R (Let's Bounce!) engage buries her once Rebuttal is spent; she can't out-DPS a tank sitting on top.

edits.before: Bank E to close the gap the instant her W root is down
edits.after: Bank E to close the gap the instant Solar Snare (E) is down

edits.before: All-in when her R (reflect) is on cooldown
edits.after: All-in when her W (Rebuttal) is on cooldown

edits.before: Root you with W (Solar Snare) then kite backward
edits.after: Root you with E (Solar Snare) then kite backward

edits.before: Hold R reflect to punish your committed all-in
edits.after: Hold W Rebuttal to punish your committed all-in

edits.before: At 6 her R reflect and burst spike punish blind all-ins.
edits.after: At 6 Golden Eclipse detonates Overwhelm from any range.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are yours as long as her W (Solar Snare) root is down — close with E, sit on her, and she can't escape a tank. The one caution is level 6: her R (Rekindled Ember) reflect plus Executioner-style burst can punish a blind all-in, so bait or wait out her ult before you commit. Play around that cooldown and the lane stays comfortably in your favour.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are yours as long as her E (Solar Snare, 11s) is down — close with E, sit on her, and she can't escape a tank. The real caution is her W: Rebuttal blanks your damage for its duration and is 38s at rank 1, so force it out before you commit anything. Play around that one cooldown and the lane stays comfortably in your favour.

edits.before: Mel out-pokes you at level 1 — her ranged abilities and passive chip your blobs while you have no way to reach her, so don't force it and just soak with your passive. By level 2 it's a wash as she runs low on mana, and from 3 onward you flip it: E (Elastic Slingshot) onto her and W (Unstable Matter) shreds a champ with no dash and a thin health bar.
edits.after: Mel out-pokes you at level 1 — Radiant Volley reaches 950 to your Q's 800, so she chips your blobs for free while you soak with your passive and give ground. By level 2 her mana runs thin, and from 3 onward you flip it: E (Elastic Slingshot) onto her and W (Unstable Matter) shreds a champ with no dash and a thin health bar.

edits.before: Weather the poke — slingshot him on the Solar Snare cooldown and out-sustain on blobs. Zac wins the Solar Snare cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather the poke — slingshot her once Rebuttal is spent and out-sustain on blobs. Zac wins the Rebuttal cooldown windows.

edits.before: Slingshot him on the Solar Snare cooldown and out-sustain on blobs. Track Solar Snare before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Slingshot her once Rebuttal is spent and out-sustain on blobs. Track Rebuttal before every commit and keep the wave on your side.

edits.before: Every blob you collect is a trade he paid for. Only take the trade when Mel's Solar Snare is down.
edits.after: Every blob you collect is a trade she paid for. Only take the trade when Mel's Solar Snare is down.

edits.before: Elastic Slingshot from fog + R bounces win every river fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Mel's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Golden Eclipse detonates her Overwhelm stacks from any range on the map. Walking away stops saving you — bait Rebuttal instead.

edits.before: - Mel Solar Snare: matchup-defining — Her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Mel Solar Snare (E, 11s): her root / slow zone — sets up her combo. Dodge it. - Mel Rebuttal (W, 38s): matchup-defining — blanks your damage, so bait it first. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: The packet flagged spikes[2] 'Let's Bounce' as a probable wrong ability name. It is a FALSE POSITIVE — the text on disk already reads 'Let's Bounce!' with the exclamation mark; the detector strips trailing punctuation before comparing. Every 'Let's Bounce' suspectName across the Zac packet is the same false positive. The real name errors in this matchup were 'Rekindled Ember' (not a Mel ability), Solar Snare filed as W instead of E, and the reflect attributed to R instead of W (Rebuttal). Mel is referred to with male pronouns throughout the full layer; I fixed the two strings that were uniquely addressable (tldr/winCon carried 'him', phases[1].why carried 'he'), but the same misgendering remains in breakdown.early/mid/wave/feeding, dosFull, dontsFull and several report[] entries because those strings are byte-identical across many matchups and the applier refuses ambiguous full-layer replacements. Also note the full layer's phases[].side for this matchup happens to match content win[] — that is NOT true for the other eight matchups in this slice (see the other proposal files).
